videos.title: Minecraft Mod Spotlight ~Iron Chest ~ Mod Tutorial

order.note: The mod has no tools and no prerequisites - the first craft is simply a wooden chest wrapped in a metal. Copper and iron are both valid entries straight off a vanilla chest.
After the first metal chest the mod is purely a climb; there is nothing else to learn.

ladder.note: MAIN LADDER, verified from recipes - each chest is crafted from the previous chest plus a material. Copper is an optional first rung (wood goes straight to iron too). At diamond the ladder BRANCHES rather than continuing in a line.

The branch: obsidian and crystal are BOTH made from a diamond chest and neither leads to the other. Obsidian is the blast-resistant end point; crystal is the see-through one. Treating them as sequential tiers would be wrong.
Parallel upgrade-item path: rather than re-crafting, an upgrade item converts a placed chest in-world without unloading it. One upgrade item per step of the ladder, including both diamond branches.
Every tier has a trapped variant, made by adding a tripwire hook to the finished chest. These are side-grades, never rungs.

gates.note: Only vanilla materials gate this mod: copper, iron, gold, diamond, obsidian and glass. Diamond chests need glass as well as diamonds, which is the one non-obvious ingredient.
In-world upgrade items are the intended way to climb once a chest is full - crafting the next tier directly means emptying the old one first.

payoff.note: The very first rung already feels like a win - the guide stresses that a vanilla chest is 27 slots while the copper chest is 45 (9x5), 'definitely a huge upgrade'. Slot counts continue iron 54 (9x6), gold 81 (9x9), diamond 108 (12x9). Front-loading that first craft is what sells the mod.
The diamond chest is where the mod stops mattering for most players - it is the point where storage stops being the constraint.
The crystal chest's transparency is a genuine quality-of-life pick, not just cosmetic - contents are readable without opening.

traps.note: The dirt chest is a joke item, not a tier - the guide calls it 'the dirt chest 9000', a troll item with a SINGLE slot. It must never appear on the ladder even though its name pattern matches the real chests.

GUIDE CONTRADICTS THE JAR: the video walks through eight tiers including a SILVER chest (72 slots) between iron and gold. There is no silver chest in the installed 1.20.1 Forge jar - the 21 real ids cover dirt, copper, iron, gold, diamond, obsidian and crystal only. Silver is a leftover from older versions/forks. Any quest built from that video's ladder would reference an item that does not exist.

signature.note: The metal chest line is the entire mod - one of the oldest and most recognisable storage ladders in modded Minecraft.
